title: The owner's twenty-first notes: Isao's lines at their own moments and fewer early, every MK-9 announced, the Lancer at the body with a wider burn, the Needle's quieter click and centred on its pedestal, a DROP-OFF POINT board, a lost hull's part left where it fell, Isao closing the rock beside a wall
context: Owner, 2026-10-05 (live, d56e9279): 1) too many voices too early; 'the Stålheart stands, your MÖRK is rolling out' long before the Stålheart; 'twenty-five, show-off' at a ram bonus of 16; 'fifty, I'm writing that down' whatever the count. 2) the Lancer aims a little low; its burned ground too small. 3) a dedicated, signed drop-off point for the packages: a minimalist scoreboard reading DROP-OFF POINT. 4) a MÖRK lost carrying a package should leave it on the ground there. 5) the Needle's reload click too loud. 6) wall breaches: a wall covering half a tile and the swarm still through; close one wall more than seems needed. 7) the RAM x10 call too low, stop calling it. 8) the Needle stands outside its pedestal. 9) every gunship Tactical Nuke must have Isao's announcement.
outcome: 1) content/voice-hooks.js VOICE_LINE_MOMENTS: a line that names a moment plays only there (the Stålheart's 'stands' and 'builds the tanks' lines at stalheart_stands, its 'at the pole' lines at stalheart_begins; each RAM number at its own milestone); VOICE_TUNE.space (4 s of quiet after any line before an unprompted pick; a brief's next shown line and a forced line do not wait) and rest per trigger (print_done 60 s, build_start 45 s, idle 90 s, good_hit 30 s). 7) RAM x10 no longer speaks. 9) gunship-rig launchHeavy announces every launched MK-9 (manned and automated) with a forced line that stops whatever he is saying. 2) src/fx/lance-follow.js bodyAt: the Lancer's head, line-of-sight check, shot and held beam aim at the body as drawn (its pos lifted lift x size), not its feet; its scorch 0.45 -> 1.1 cells. 5) scripts/derive-needle-fire.sh: the Needle plays the main gun's report with its reload clicks (0.70-0.92 s) 12 dB down (assets/audio/needle_fire.mp3, pinned to its source); the tank keeps tank_main. 8) towerlooks fits every sentry on its YAW pivot instead of its bounding box (the Needle's long barrel had pulled the box forward off the pedestal). 3) expedition-glue: a small split-flap board (0.6 of the base's) at the head of the trophy row reads DROP-OFF POINT with HOME, FIELD and SITES. 4) domain hullLost(st, cell): a part dropped by a lost hull waits on the cell the hull died on (s.at); the flag, the pickup and the radar use it. 6) repair-orders rimHoles: an open cell beside a rim wall that was rock (the breach record) is a hole for Isao too, the doors, the back mouth and the canyon's carved floor kept.
alternatives: Muting the early triggers outright: the owner wants the voice, fewer and in place, not gone
Reprocessing tank_main.mp3 for the Needle's click: the tank's own report would lose its reload
Filling every open cell in the rim band: the gate lane and interior floor lie in the band; only rock that was blown open is refilled
evidence: --round22 (new): Isao announced the manned MK-9 (mk9_release_06); the Needle centred on its pedestal; the DROP-OFF POINT board by the landing (screenshots)

unit tests: line moments, forced line, space and rests (isao-voice), RAM x10 silent (voice-match), rimHoles and shotHoles (repair-orders), hullLost at a cell (expeditions, cargo); the Needle's click measured -2 -> -15 dB peak
